responsibility: This definition file declares the D-specific target hook interface used to extend GCC back ends for the D frontend. Through `DEFHOOK` entries it specifies hooks for predefined CPU/OS version identifiers, `__traits(getTargetInfo)` key registration, ModuleInfo section naming and bracket symbols, stdcall-convention support, and template emission policy, serving as the source from which the D target hook structures and accessors are generated.
same_name_distinction: This file is the hook-definition table for the d-target group: it enumerates TARGET_D-style hooks and POD defaults for back ends to provide, whereas d-target.h turns that table into C++ hook structures/declarations and d-target.cc consumes those hooks while implementing actual target behavior.
